We observed the object staying on a straight path for about 4 minutes, slightly dimming, and then blinking totally out. I checked out the sky to see if maybe there was cloud cover to the west of us, but other astronomical objects were visible at the same angle in the sky with the naked eye. My background in visual observations is from being an amateur astronomer since around 1970, running a college planetarium in college, watching SkyLab crossings in the 70's, and watching obvious satellite transits. I haven't ever seen anything prior to this I would describe as a UFO/UAP. Curious to see if anyone else observed this object in the area as well.
